classification: dirty-tree native diagnostic; not new signed or WPT qualification
change: Trusted Types/eval policy is stored on each native V8 context instead of one RawV8Host-wide cache. Legacy realm inheritance explicitly snapshots the active creator context, and later policy configuration replaces only the owning context's policy.

regression.name: native_document_policy_belongs_to_its_realm_not_last_configured_sibling
regression.before: A new realm created from a restricted parent incorrectly allowed raw HTML and eval after a different sibling was configured unrestricted: false,false instead of true,true.
regression.after: The active creator's policy is inherited; both restricted-parent/unrestricted-sibling and unrestricted-parent/restricted-sibling cases pass, and existing sibling policies remain unchanged.
regression.initial_probe_limitation: An earlier probe attempted to reinstall generated bindings in an existing context and failed with V8 failed to allocate Window.location property. That distinct document-reuse limitation is not fixed or used as policy-regression evidence.

remaining: The loader still needs explicit inherited-local-document versus navigation-response policy selection; legacy inheritance is preserved here, not claimed fully conformant.
Synchronous initial iframe creation and Window/document reuse must avoid reinstalling unforgeable global properties.
Native WindowProxy linking, per-document broker routing, persisted SaaS outcomes and broader qualification remain open.
No new signed, WPT, performance or clean-source qualification is claimed.
